findings.message: Function create_function() is deprecated since PHP 7.2 and removed since PHP 8.0; Use an anonymous function instead

Since PHP 7.0, functions inspecting arguments, like debug_backtrace(), no longer report the original value as passed to a parameter, but will instead provide the current value. The parameter "$output" was changed on line 14. (PHP 7.0 behaviour: func_get_args() and similar report the current value of a changed parameter, and code that runs on PHP 7 or 8 today already gets this, so the upgrade changes nothing)
